tools.name: build-tool-link
tools.description: Return the right ColdProxy free-tool URL for proxy testing, public IP checks, or IPv6 checks.

proxy.description: Proxy string for proxy-checker deep links. Ignored by other tools.

domain.description: Domain or URL for ipv6-checker deep links. Ignored by other tools.

openNow.description: When true, open the generated URL in the current tab.

tools.name: choose-proxy-plan
tools.description: Recommend the best ColdProxy plan family for a workload and return the best matching pricing URLs.

useCase.description: Workload such as scraping, QA, SEO monitoring, social automation, public APIs, or geo testing.

needsStrictSiteSupport.description: Set true for stricter websites that need residential IPs. Residential IPv6 leads when needsIpv6 is true; otherwise both Residential IPv4 plans suit them and the billing preference (prefersUsageBilling or a small, light, pilot, test, or starter workload) picks between them.

needsIpv6.description: Set true when the target publishes IPv6 addresses or is served by a supported CDN (check with the IPv6 Checker).

prefersUsageBilling.description: Set true when monthly traffic packs suit the budget better than an Mbps speed tier.

openBestMatch.description: When true, open the best matching pricing page in the current tab.

tools.name: route-support-request
tools.description: Route a user to the best ColdProxy support channel for billing, abuse, setup, or sales questions.

topic.description: Support topic such as billing, refunds, abuse, setup, connectivity, or sales.

openNow.description: When true, open the recommended support URL in the current tab.
